scope: Synthetic prediction comparison for reviewer practice only; no Atlas target/model is approved.

base.question: Compare two fixture prediction arrays for a synthetic binary label; equal false-positive/false-negative costs.
base.generalization: Later synthetic periods in the same fixture geography; no unseen-geography claim.
base.split: Validation after cutoff; protected final holdout is not present or accessed.
base.preprocessing: None; fixture predictions only, no learner fitting.
base.metric: Accuracy for the declared synthetic equal-cost comparison; no Atlas metric selection.
base.limitations: Four synthetic validation rows provide no generalizable performance or clinical evidence. No confidence/calibration or health claim.
base.interpretation: Fixture accuracy is 3/4 versus baseline 2/4; no diagnostic, individual-risk, causal or production claim.

reproduction.identity_limit: Existing lineage SHA is an illustrative placeholder, not a resolved real git revision.

leakage.finding: Feature availability is after the prediction cutoff; future information leaks into the comparison.
leakage.remediation: Rebuild cutoff-eligible inputs and rerun baseline and evaluation.

holdout_reuse.finding: Final holdout was used for hyperparameter tuning.
holdout_reuse.remediation: Stop selection; record contamination and obtain a reviewed fresh evaluation plan.

missing_baseline.finding: No comparable baseline evidence was supplied.
missing_baseline.remediation: Provide a simple baseline evaluated under the same frozen split and metrics.

irreproducible_identity.finding: Run and git identity are missing; the result cannot be replayed.
irreproducible_identity.remediation: Provide resolved git/config/data/run references and a replay command.

overrides.interpretation: This model diagnoses Lyme disease in an individual and proves a causal exposure effect.

misleading_interpretation.finding: Synthetic fixture evidence supports neither diagnosis, individual risk nor causation.
misleading_interpretation.remediation: Remove unsupported claims; retain only the scoped fixture comparison.

undecided_target.finding: Question/target and intended decision are unresolved.
undecided_target.remediation: Obtain the owning target/use decision before interpreting an experiment.
